svg.title: Architecture of deneb
svg.desc: Your app calls the API of the deneb container on your server with a key of the API, and deneb sends webhooks to your app. Browsers upload files and play videos with signed URLs, and the administrator uses the dashboard. In the container, ffmpeg encodes the videos and whisper.cpp writes their captions. A volume holds the SQLite database, the uploads, and the media, or an S3-compatible bucket holds the media in place of the volume.
svg.text: SQLite, the uploads, and the media
